title: Pindarus
summary: Raleigh names Pindarus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Pindarus, out of whom Natalis takes the exposition of Tantalus and the Nectar of the Gods. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. II, sig. 264a
